item.title: RECE DAVIS on working with NICK SABAN, his viral LANK moment, why there is BELIEF in Kalen DeBoer!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: ESPN legend Rece Davis, host of "College GameDay" and the network's new show "Official Visit with Rece Davis," joins Ben Flanagan to talk about why there is belief in Kalen DeBoer's third season, what it's like working with Nick Saban, and what he's learned from the best college football coaches in the country. Davis shares which celebrity guest pickers left him starstruck, which stadium he loves the most, why he had to wave off Coach Saban during a "GameDay" segment, and the wild things he saw as an RA at the University of Alabama.
